_comment: Copy-paste MCP configurations for connecting to the MindCrafts AI MCP server. Pick the one that matches your client and environment.

desktop_remote_stdio_proxy._description: Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor, or Windsurf - remote WordPress via official Automattic STDIO proxy

env.WP_API_PASSWORD: xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx

claude_desktop_local_wpcli._description: Claude Desktop - local WordPress via WP-CLI

claude_code_mcp_json._description: Claude Code - place as .mcp.json in project root

direct_http_streamable._description: Direct HTTP fallback for clients that fully support Streamable HTTP sessions

mcp_inspector_wpcli._description: MCP Inspector - test and debug tools via WP-CLI

mcp_remote_proxy_command._description: Raw command shape for the official remote proxy
mcp_remote_proxy_command._command_windows: set WP_API_URL=https://your-site.com/wp-json/mcp/mindcrafts-ai-server && set WP_API_USERNAME=admin && set WP_API_PASSWORD=xxxx && set OAUTH_ENABLED=false && npx.cmd -y @automattic/mcp-wordpress-remote@latest
